rules.title: RSO Annual Allowable Rent Increase
rules.requirement: Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) are limited to 3% for the period July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026.
rules.coverage_text: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO).
rules.citation: City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)
rules.quoted_span: Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective

rules.title: RSO Utility Percentage Increase Elimination
rules.requirement: Beginning February 2, 2026, a landlord of an RSO unit can no longer include any additional percentage increase for utilities.
